ruleset_toml:
[meta]
# Bumped with every deliberate balance/engine change, per
# tuning/CHANGELOG.md and determinism/README.md's update procedure.
# The filename (rulesets/2026.1.toml) tracks the ruleset *family*; this
# tracks the specific revision within it.
version = "2026.5"

[timing]
tick_rate            = 60      # ticks per second
round_ticks          = 3600    # 60 seconds (v0.2 Change 4: 5400 -> 3600; prefer shortening the round over inflating damage - timeouts are a spectator problem before a balance problem)
intermission_ticks   = 480     # 8 seconds
opening_freeze_ticks = 90      # inputs discarded during this
rounds_to_win        = 2       # best of 3
max_rounds           = 1

[arena]
arena_width          = 2400    # units
ceiling              = 900
fighter_height       = 1000
fighter_width        = 72
start_separation     = 100
start_separation_jitter = 0   # actual separation drawn uniformly from [start_separation - jitter, + jitter], once per match, from the match seed

[meters]
vitality             = 50
surge_max            = 300
guard_max            = 100

[agent]
observation_delay    = 4       # ticks the agent's view lags reality
reflex_interval      = 5       # agents are polled every N ticks

[movement]
gravity              = 3200    # units per second squared
walk_speed           = 340     # units per second
dash_speed           = 900
dash_ticks           = 14
jump_velocity        = 1500

[sudden_death]
ticks                = 1800
vitality              = 250

[passivity]
warning_ticks        = 480   # v0.2 Change 3: 300 -> 480 (8s); a penalty everyone pays is a tax, not a penalty
penalty_fraction_pct = 10      # percent of current vitality subtracted on 2nd warning

[guard_crush]
crush_ticks          = 40
refill_to            = 50

[throw]
tech_window_ticks    = 7

[pushback]
# Pushback is what makes block strings end naturally instead of requiring a
# frame-data rule to stop them: both fighters separate on block (defender
# more than attacker), and the defender separates on a clean hit too.
block_defender       = 30
block_attacker       = 10
hit_defender         = 20
hit_attacker         = 0

[frame_data]
# Moves listed here are allowed to be 0-or-better on block without failing
# the `kadu frames --check` / CI frame-data gate. Empty by default: every
# strike should have a real, punishable gap on block. Add a move here only
# alongside a comment explaining why it's exempt.
block_advantage_whitelist = []

[moves.light]
startup = 4
active = 2
recovery = 10   # v0.2 Change 2: 7 -> 10, makes Light -3 on block instead of the +0 infinite block string it was
damage = 30
block_damage = 6
hitstun = 12
blockstun = 8
guard_damage = 6
hitstop = 4

[moves.medium]
startup = 7
active = 3
recovery = 14
damage = 60
block_damage = 12
hitstun = 18
blockstun = 12
guard_damage = 12
hitstop = 6

[moves.heavy]
startup = 12
active = 4
recovery = 22
damage = 100
block_damage = 20
hitstun = 26
blockstun = 16
guard_damage = 22
hitstop = 10

[moves.throw]
startup = 5
active = 2
recovery = 20
damage = 120
hitstop = 8

[combo]
scaling_pct = [100, 90, 80, 70, 60, 50]
floor_pct = 20
hard_knockdown_hit = 15

[hitboxes]
# Rectangles are [x_offset, y_offset, width, height] relative to fighter origin (feet, facing-forward-positive x).
# Standing normals
light_hitbox    = [40, 550, 90, 120]
medium_hitbox   = [40, 500, 110, 160]
heavy_hitbox    = [40, 450, 130, 220]
throw_hitbox    = [30, 400, 80, 300]
# Crouching normals (lower)
light_hitbox_crouch  = [40, 250, 90, 120]
medium_hitbox_crouch = [40, 220, 110, 140]
# Hurtboxes (six regions), standing
hurt_head      = [-30, 850, 60, 150]
hurt_torso     = [-40, 500, 80, 350]
hurt_arm_left  = [-70, 500, 30, 300]
hurt_arm_right = [40, 500, 30, 300]
hurt_leg_left  = [-40, 0, 35, 500]
hurt_leg_right = [5, 0, 35, 500]
# Hurtboxes, crouching (compressed vertically)
hurt_head_crouch      = [-30, 500, 60, 130]
hurt_torso_crouch     = [-40, 250, 80, 260]
hurt_arm_left_crouch  = [-70, 250, 30, 220]
hurt_arm_right_crouch = [40, 250, 30, 220]
hurt_leg_left_crouch  = [-40, 0, 35, 260]
hurt_leg_right_crouch = [5, 0, 35, 260]
